title: ULIQ Testnet Hub
subtitle: Presale, vesting, utility locking, and entitlements in one traceable testnet flow.
legalNotice: Testnet / provisional. ADR-001 remains blocked; this is not a live offering or Mainnet approval.
unavailable: ULIQ is not enabled in this environment.
walletMismatch: Connect the server-linked wallet {wallet} on Arbitrum Sepolia.

sale.title: Presale status
sale.description: Finalized block data, hard-cap progress, and the current maximum purchase.

purchase.title: Prepare testnet purchase
purchase.description: Enter a USDC amount, review the contract quote, then confirm approval and purchase in your wallet.
purchase.partial: Partial fill: the contract accepts only the remaining available amount.
purchase.inactive: Purchases are available only while the sale is ACTIVE. Current state: {state}.
purchase.pending: After purchase, the allocation remains fully inactive until the withdrawal period has ended. tUSDC remains in escrow until withdrawal or finalization and is released to the treasury when finalized.

entitlement.title: Entitlement
entitlement.description: Wallet + unreleased vesting + locked, block-consistent and excluding pending presale allocations.

vesting.title: Presale vesting
vesting.description: 75% of each finalized allocation vests linearly from the global DEX launch timestamp.
vesting.claimPending: Claim confirmed · Finality pending. The released amount will update automatically.
vesting.waiting: Waiting for the global DEX launch timestamp. No vesting release is available yet.

locking.title: Utility locking
locking.description: Pure utility locking for 1, 6, or 12 months — without APY, rewards, or distributions. A longer term does not increase the discount.
locking.positionsDescription: Finalized lock terms and their current coverage for new subscription terms.
locking.extensionNotNeeded: This lock already covers the selected term.
locking.extensionPending: Extension confirmed · finality and indexer reconciliation continue in the background.
locking.discountGate: Feature access uses the full eligible ULIQ balance. Monetary discounts additionally require at least 25% of the current tier minimum to be finalized and locked through the exact subscription end.
locking.checkoutRequiredUntil: The failed checkout requires lock coverage through {until}. Select the required checkout end below and confirm the extension in your wallet.

purchases.title: Presale purchases
purchases.empty: No purchases for this wallet yet.
purchases.trackedSubmitted: The wallet submitted the transaction. The receipt and purchase data are being verified.
purchases.trackedSoftConfirmed: Purchase successful – {usdc} USDC, {uliq} ULIQ. Finality is checked automatically in the background.
purchases.trackedSafe: Purchase confirmed – {usdc} USDC, {uliq} ULIQ. Final network finality is still pending.
purchases.trackedFinalized: Network finality is confirmed. The indexer is moving the purchase into its final presale state.
purchases.trackedFailed: The purchase transaction did not execute successfully. No benefits were enabled.
purchases.trackedReorged: The receipt block is no longer part of the confirmed chain. The purchase remains locked for review.
purchases.trackedReviewRequired: The receipt or purchase data could not be matched unambiguously. The purchase remains locked for review.
purchases.withdrawSyncingHint: The withdrawal was confirmed and the tUSDC were refunded. The indexer status is being reconciled; no further confirmation is required.
purchases.finalizeSyncingHint: Finalization was submitted. The wallet transaction and indexer status are being reconciled; no further confirmation is required.
purchases.pendingInactive: Pending allocation: 0 ULIQ available and 0 benefits active until finalization.

messages.txSubmitted: Transaction submitted. Waiting for one confirmation …
messages.txConfirmed: Wallet transaction confirmed. The indexer will refresh the status shortly.
messages.txReverted: The wallet transaction reverted and was not executed.
messages.txCancelled: The wallet transaction was cancelled or replaced by a cancellation transaction.
messages.approvalConfirmed: Approval confirmed. Please sign the main transaction now.
messages.purchaseSoftConfirmed: Purchase successful – {usdc} USDC, {uliq} ULIQ. Finality is checked automatically in the background.
messages.purchaseTrackingDelayed: The wallet transaction was confirmed. Purchase matching is delayed and will retry automatically in the background; benefits remain locked until true finality.
messages.purchaseTrackingReview: The confirmed wallet transaction could not be verified unambiguously as a valid presale purchase. Benefits remain locked; please have the transaction reviewed.
messages.tokenAdded: ULIQ was added to the wallet.
messages.tokenAddRejected: ULIQ was not added to the wallet. The wallet request was rejected.
messages.tokenAddUnsupported: This wallet could not add ULIQ automatically. Use the ULIQ contract address for a manual import instead.
messages.walletRequired: A matching linked wallet is required.
messages.actionFailed: The action could not be completed.

billing.hint: Checkout validates the linked wallet and creates an exact 10-minute reservation. ULIQ is never used as payment.
billing.unavailable: The ULIQ discount cannot be reserved right now. The checkout was not created.
billing.lockGateFailure: The discount requires {required} ULIQ locked through {until}. Currently {qualifying} ULIQ cover that term. Continue at standard price or extend the lock.
billing.lockStateStale: The finalized lock state is not current yet. The discount stays blocked until indexer reconciliation; standard pricing remains available.
billing.aiSubscriptionRequired: The AI credit discount is available only during an active subscription already purchased with a ULIQ discount.
billing.aiCapExceeded: This tier's monthly AI discount cap has been reached. Standard pricing remains available.

admin.title: ULIQ Operations
admin.subtitle: Indexer, reconciliation, price quality, reservations, and Safe-compatible preparation — without server signing.
admin.testnetNotice: Testnet operations only. ADR-001 is blocked and no server-side signing or broadcast is available.
admin.tiersDescription: Versioned thresholds and discounts. The testnet migration defaults all monetary discounts to zero.
admin.lockGateDescription: Monetary discounts require finalized lock coverage through the exact subscription end. Feature access remains independent.
admin.lockGateAuditHint: Discount and AI-cap changes create a new tier version audited with actor, reason, old value, and new value.
admin.treasuryDescription: Store the desired receiving wallet, verify onchain state, and prepare Safe-compatible transactions for a controlled rotation.
admin.treasuryTwoStep: Rotation is two-step: the contract owner proposes the new treasury, then that exact treasury must accept the role itself. The API never signs or submits transactions.
admin.treasuryDesiredHint: Mainnet requires a dedicated multisig/Safe wallet; never a personal EOA.
admin.treasurySaved: Desired treasury address saved and reconciled with finalized onchain state.
admin.dexPendingDescription: Checks the finalized sale state, open purchases, active treasury, finalized allocation, and presale inventory. The API simulates the transition to DEX_PENDING but never signs or submits it.
admin.safeDescription: Set the date and time, verify finalized onchain state, and confirm the DEX launch once in the owner wallet or Safe. Receipt and finality are then tracked automatically.
admin.prepared: Safe-compatible payload prepared and audited. Nothing was signed or submitted.
admin.fourEyes: The external Safe must be verified with a signer threshold of at least 2 before this payload is approved.
admin.externalPoolNotice: The assistant does not create or fund a DEX pool. You prepare and verify the pool, pair, liquidity, and opening price externally.
admin.externalPoolConfirmation: The DEX pool, pair, liquidity, and opening price have been prepared and verified externally.
admin.poolConfirmationRequired: External pool readiness must be confirmed before the DEX launch.
admin.stepDexPendingHint: Sale ended, no open purchases, and DEX_PENDING finalized.
admin.stepScheduleHint: Set the date and local time.
admin.immutableTimestamp: The timestamp cannot be changed after onchain confirmation and also sets the global vesting start.
admin.walletRequired: Connect the owner wallet to confirm directly. Alternatively, prepare a Safe payload.
admin.ownerMismatch: The connected wallet is not contract owner {owner}. Use the owner wallet or the Safe payload.
admin.invalidTimestamp: The DEX launch timestamp must be valid and in the future.
admin.invalidPreparedTransaction: The prepared transaction is invalid or cannot be submitted directly through this wallet.
admin.transactionSubmitted: DEX launch transaction submitted. Receipt and finality are tracked automatically.
admin.receiptConfirmed: DEX launch confirmed. Network finality continues in the background.
admin.transactionCancelled: The DEX launch transaction was cancelled or replaced in the wallet.
admin.noPayload: No payload has been prepared yet.
